• EPS of $0.33, unchanged for the quarter • Adjusted EPS (1) , which excludes the impact of Notable Items (as detailed in "Notable Items Influencing Earnings") was $0.38, down $0.01 from the prior quarter • ROTCE (1) of 14.6% and adjusted ROTCE (1)(2) of 16.6% • Net interest income increased 1% quarter-over-quarter; NIM of 3.25% was up 4 basis points driven by higher yields on investment securities and modestly lower overall net funding costs • Noninterest income decreased 8% quarter-over-quarter, largely due to lower capital markets fees and unfavorable equity valuation adjustments • Noninterest expense, excluding the impact of acquisition-related expenses, remained flat quarter-over-quarter • Average total loans and leases were down 0.4% compared to the prior quarter driven by declines in CRE and total consumer loans, partially offset by higher C&I loans • Average total deposits increased 0.2% quarter-over-quarter, with higher money market and interest-bearing demand balances, partially offset by lower time deposits • Maintained strong capital position, with CET1 risk-based capital ratio of 10.1% (3) , adjusted CET1 (1) risk-based capital ratio of 8.9% (3) , and TCE (1) ratio of 6.9% • TBV per common share (1) of $9.47 was down $0.18, or 2%, from the prior quarter, largely due to the impact of market interest rates unfavorably impacting AOCI • Repurchase d $100 million of common shares, bringing the total to $409 million and representing approximately 25 million shares repurchased year‑to‑date
